items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I told Duke you better get one of them off because Tizol is going to cut them down. That was awful. But I told Duke, Mingus' fault, Mingus was a agitator.

ctx.x: Did you know Barney very well.

I didn't know him very well but he and Tizol, they were two guys that left early, see. But Tizol -- Charlie Mingus, remember when Charlie Mingus was with the band. He died here recently and Charlie was with the band and he and Tricky -- I mean, what's the name the trombone player, Tizol, they couldn't get along.
They had that big fight at the Apollo Theatre. Were you there that time.
